recentItems.title: Khamenei says US midterms won’t change Washington’s hostility towards Iran
recentItems.description:
Iran's supreme leader has renewed his criticism of the United States.
This comes as Tehran is signalling defiance towards Washington following the midterm elections.   
There has been reaction on the streets of Iran.
Protesters have dismissed any distinction between Democrats and Republicans, saying neither party will change the US approach toward Iran.
They have also portrayed the outcome as a victory for the Islamic Republic.

Al Jazeera’s Resul Serdar reports from Tehran, Iran.
